node.title: Re: Behaviour of parsed XML
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: An [id://1177642|SSCCE] would be helpful here; for example we don't know if you're using the ForceArray option. In any case, [mod://XML::Simple] is extremely brittle (see the warning at the top of its documentation) and I would very strongly recommend trying to move away from it. I've shown how to use [mod://XML::Rules] as a replacement several times, see [id://1232006|this node] and the links therein.
